$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFLT (AIP France, chart dated 2023-08-10): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Montluçon - Domérat

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved for: home-based ACFT; ACFT exceptionnally authorized by AD operator.
For ACFT, pilot must have been indicated able to use AD by an instructor (or hold an instructor qualification).
If wind blowing from E possibility of high downdrafts QFU 109°.
ARRIVALS / DEPARTURES FROM EAST: Proceed via N or S point for noise abatement.
LDG RWY 29: Do not go beyond the Cher river on base leg.
TWY B one-way (from RWY intersection to A).
Take-off RWY 29: do not turn before the bridge on the RN 145 and avoid flying over Domérat.
